codings.one_line: Cornell study found Whisper speech-to-text hallucinates violent/fabricated text in ~1% of clips, especially with speech pauses.
codings.rationale: This is a benchmark/research finding on aggregate hallucination rates, not a documented interaction where a deployed conversational or agentic system harmed a specific end user; Whisper is a transcription tool, not a chatbot/voice agent conversing with users.

codings.one_line: Figma's Make Design AI feature generated UI mockups nearly identical to Apple's Weather app from ordinary text prompts.
codings.rationale: Designers used the intended text-to-design feature in ordinary good-faith fashion and it produced infringing-looking output, meeting the normative (C) test; the fallout (feature pulled, embarrassment) is reputational with no lawsuit or fine documented.

codings.one_line: OpenAI's SearchGPT prototype gave wrong dates for a North Carolina music festival in response to an ordinary search query.
codings.rationale: An ordinary, good-faith search query that would pass unnoticed in normal traffic produced hallucinated/incorrect information, meeting the normative (C) test; the documented harm is embarrassment with no legal or financial consequence.

codings.one_line: Amazon's Alexa gave a detailed endorsement for Harris but refused the same request about Trump, which Amazon called an error.
codings.rationale: Users asked Alexa an ordinary, good-faith question about candidates and got an inconsistent/biased answer, fitting the normative (C) test; the fallout was public backlash and reputational damage with no confirmed legal action.
